transcript: Speaker A (AI): School Group Mein English Se Ghabra Gyi Kya? [Did you get scared of English in the school group?] Speaker B (Human): Haan, Baaki Saare Bachhon Ki Mammiyan WhatsApp Group Pe Heavy English Likhti Hain. Main Bas Thumbs Up Bhejti Hun. [Yes, all the other kids' moms write heavy English on the WhatsApp group. I just send a thumbs up.] Speaker A (AI): Chup Mat Raho. SpeakEasy App Try Karo. Mere Saath Roz Natural English Bolo. [Don't stay silent. Try SpeakEasy App. Speak natural English with me every day.] Speaker B (Human): Par Mujhe Seekhne Mein Thoda Time Lagta Hai. Mera Mazaak To Nahi Banega? [But it takes me some time to learn. Will I be made fun of?] Speaker A (AI): Bilkul Nahi. Mere Saath Aaraam Se Practice Karo. Galti Karne Ki Koi Chinta Nahi. [Not at all. Practice comfortably with me. No need to worry about making mistakes.] Speaker B (Human): Waah! Par Ghar Ke Kaamon Ke Beech Lambi Classes Lene Ka Vakt Kahan Milta Hai? [Wow! But where is the time to take long classes amidst household chores?] Speaker A (AI): Koi Lambi Class Nahi. Din Ke Sirf 15 Minute Practice Karo Aur Trial Bhi Sirf ’1 Mein Hai. [No long classes. Practice just 15 minutes a day and the trial is also for just ’1.] Speaker B (Human): Perfect. Phir To Agli School Meeting Mein Main Confidently Baat Karungi. [Perfect. Then in the next school meeting, I will speak confidently.] Speaker A (AI): Apne Bache Ki Super Mummy Bano. SpeakEasy App Ke Saath English Bolna Shuru Karo. [Become your child's super mummy. Start speaking English with SpeakEasy App.] Speaker B (Human): Bilkul, Apni Nai Pehchaan Banane Ke Liye Main Aaj Hi Install Karti Hu. [Absolutely, to create my new identity, I will install it today.] Speaker C (Human): Abhi SpeakEasy App download karein aur farratedar English bolna shuru karein. [Download SpeakEasy App now and start speaking fluent English.]
